impact: A clean beat and raise eases fears that AI demand is cracking, which supports the memory names (MU, DRAM, SNXX) and AI infrastructure (NBIS) after a heavy November selloff, and backs the capex story for MSFT and GOOGL. The lower margin guide and the extra week in Q4 temper it, so watch whether the after-hours gain holds at Wednesday's open.
source: Nvidia release via StockTitan / Investing.com / FXStreet / Motley Fool
summary: Nvidia reported fiscal Q3 2027 revenue of $115.8B, up 103% y/y and 20% q/q, versus about $108.9B expected, with adjusted EPS of $2.68 vs $2.47 expected. It guided Q4 revenue to $130B plus or minus 3% versus about $125B consensus, assuming no data center compute revenue from China, but guided gross margin down to 71% to 72% from about 74.8%. It was the first report under interim CEO Colette Kress; shares rose roughly 2% to 4% after hours (above $160) after closing down 0.4%, a smaller move than the roughly 8% options had priced.
title: Nvidia Q3 revenue $115.8B (+103%), guides Q4 to $130B; shares up after hours
